summary: Phunware, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Master Software and Services Agreement with Build Something LLC for development of the Apollo 2.0 program. The agreement involves project fees up to $3,559,200 paid upon milestone achievement, with a one-year term and renewal options. This is a routine service contract for software development, not a special situation transaction. No change of control, shareholder action, or strategic event is involved.
